title: GSE Cyclic-Ordered Unimodal Slot Transport readiness
purpose: Verify that orientation-preserving cyclic transport and proper unimodal circular slots are mathematically, causally and numerically valid on the frozen development population before any training.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training COUST readiness over C01-C08 metadata and eight deterministic real rows; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed slot-transport failure attribution selecting cyclic ordered unimodal readiness.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Audit all C01-C08 metadata and load eight deterministic rows covering one through four exits.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Audit every Teacher-source join and causal reference. Eight deterministic real rows cover cardinality one through four, wrap, invalid width, fit and validation; readiness performs no sampling for performance estimation.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Targets are sorted by sensor azimuth and matched only through orientation-preserving cyclic shifts; no identity enters the model or loss.
teacher.valid_mask: Existing exact peak, independent width and global geometry masks remain unchanged.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner operation; any future edge remains physical-traversal-only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: The prior failed slot checkpoints motivate the fixed architecture but are not loaded into the readiness model.

methods.main: 788618-parameter causal circular model with K orientation-preserving cyclic assignments, equivariant angular first moment, learned concentration and a normalized discrete unimodal von-Mises projection.
methods.baseline: Failed 787328-parameter K! slot transport with diffuse K>=3 target mass and non-separable entropy confidence.
methods.fallback: Any order, unimodality, concentration, symmetry, gradient, causal or real-backward failure stops COUST before training.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 peaks and cardinality counts.
acceptance.order: Cyclic shift has invariant loss; reversed/crossing K=3 assignment has strictly larger loss.
acceptance.unimodality: Discrete mass sums to one; uniform and kappa=1000 finite; sharp slot has exactly one local maximum and concentration above 0.999.
acceptance.gradient: Duplicate K=3 slots produce a negative gradient at a missing target mode.
acceptance.symmetry: Network rotation, cyclic slot, batch permutation and repeat errors at most 3e-5.
acceptance.real_batch: All outputs, losses and gradients finite on eight real rows containing one through four exits.

failure_policy: Fail closed; do not weaken cyclic orientation, concentration bounds, symmetry tolerance, real-row coverage or isolation. Readiness PASS authorizes only a training Data Card, not training or graph.
retention: Retain summary, selected-row CSV, figures/source, environment, log, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU full metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
